verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that folk offers its own MCP server for external clients such as Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini to use. That is the server role and does not show folk itself connecting to third-party MCP servers. A CRM with AI assistants could plausibly act as an MCP client, so the axis applies, but the pack has no evidence of that capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
